elements.desc: A red fox sitting on the wooden table. The animal has orange-red fur, a white chest, pointed ears and a bushy tail. It is beside the cup.
A ceramic cup resting on the wooden table beside the red fox.
A wooden tabletop with visible natural wood grain, supporting the fox and the ceramic cup.
